planets.name: XO-4 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Koit with a 4.13-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: XO-4 b was found in 2010 by Lowell Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Koit. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility Lowell Observatory, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.12506679, pl_radj 1.25, pl_bmassj 1.42

quotes.title: XO-4b
quotes.card: XO-4b is an extrasolar planet approximately 956 light years away in the constellation of Lynx.
quotes.introduction: This planet was found by the transit method by McCullough in May 2008.
